scope: Measurement correction only; no runtime source/config/probe/attempt-count/latency-threshold changes
association: Use exact paired ordinary ASR input to locate its unique commit. Match unique non-background body whose since_turn-derived start lies in this commit interval, with 1ms integer-clock tolerance. Do not impose a 5ms start-delay cutoff. Preserve all output and unmatched bodies separately; ambiguous or absent ordinary body counts as missing, not an exclusion that can hide slow work.
input_exclusions: Keep ASR mismatch/split actual ordinary input, failed readiness/cleanup, changed runtime/persona/WAV, missing true search/resume overlap. Do not count prior query captions or body whose start precedes the target commit as current ordinary-chat output.
no_pass_claim: Original formal gate stays separate. Corrected release decision requires evaluator fixture verification, unchanged gates and full raw evidence; no pilot/old-version samples.
why_finish_fixed_budget: Existing fixed batch provides useful actual-search/resume evidence even if the old time-bin method cannot reach enough comparable pairs; no extra rooms or retries added.
